devices.name: Inbiot - MICA - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
devices.description: MICA is a smart indoor air quality monitor supporting LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity that measures temperature, relative humidity, CO₂, TVOC, PM2.5 and PM10, and delivers advanced virtual indicators including thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency, resistance to mold growth, virus spread resistance and overall indoor air quality, with optional noise monitoring and native BMS integration via Modbus and BACnet.

devices.name: Inbiot - MICA Mini - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
devices.description: MICA Mini is a compact indoor air quality sensor with LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity, measuring temperature, relative humidity and CO₂, and providing thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency and resistance to mold growth indicators, with optional noise monitoring and integration with building management systems via Modbus and BACnet.

devices.name: Inbiot - MICA Plus - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
devices.description: MICA Plus is an advanced indoor air quality monitor with LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity, measuring temperature, relative humidity, CO₂, TVOC, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM4.0, PM10 and formaldehyde, and providing thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency, resistance to mold growth, virus spread resistance and indoor air quality indicators, with optional noise monitoring and seamless integration with BMS systems through Modbus and BACnet.

devices.name: Inbiot - MICA WELL - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
devices.description: MICA WELL is the most comprehensive indoor air quality monitoring device in the MICA range, featuring LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity and measuring temperature, relative humidity, CO₂, TVOC, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM4.0, PM10, formaldehyde, ozone, NO₂ and CO, combined with thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency, resistance to mold growth, virus spread resistance and indoor air quality indicators, with optional noise monitoring and full compatibility with Modbus and BACnet for professional BMS and certification-driven projects.
